title: Provider worktree placement: accept a Windows cwd that differs from the registered worktree path only in letter case
outcome: On case-insensitive Windows storage, a test command whose explicit cwd names a linked worktree with a different letter case than Git registered (C:\repo\linked vs C:\repo\Linked) is placed in that worktree, keeping Git metadata opened without following links.
acceptance: On Windows, a provider cwd that differs from the linked worktree's registered path only in letter case keeps its provider, registration, artifact and native-completion association. Shown by a behavioural test.
A cwd in a different worktree, or outside the session's repository, is still refused. No new hashing or file-identity computation is added.
The review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input, including the Windows gate.
